title: Tamsin and the Cipher
author: Ines Eriksen
blurb: Felix Zhou, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
